summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a third-quarter trading update for the period ended 2 October 2026 and declaring an interim dividend. Q3 revenue rose 6.5% reported (5.8% FXN) to €5,764m on volume growth of 3.6%; year-to-date revenue reached €16,488m, up 5.1% reported. Management reaffirmed unchanged full-year guidance, citing zero sugar, energy and hydration demand. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is involved; the filing is a routine quarterly operational and dividend disclosure, not a special situation. Watch dividend timing and buyback cadence.
